text:
alex_cs: Quick sync for OrchidPort private VPC flip next Thu. Compliance asks: KMS cross-account scoping, audit log egress (S3 + our collector), redaction policy for model inputs, and a 5y retention attestation. Finance flagged renewal risk if cutover causes >1hr incident. Any immediate blockers?

mira_net: TGW & attachment done. Recommend VPC S3 endpoint (vpce-0f9e8d7c) to minimize latency. Need SG rule to collector.redwood.internal:443 and route table ID to publish. If endpoint not allowed, NAT will add ~12s.

raja_security: KMS: created alias/redwood/orchid-logs (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:101010101010:key/orch-555). We propose cross-account policy that allows arn:aws:iam::171717171717:role/redwood-logging Encrypt + GenerateDataKey only. Avoid cross-account Decrypt. Proposing EncryptionContext constraint: {project: "orchid"}. Snippet below for their KMS team.

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodLogging",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::171717171717:role/redwood-logging"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:101010101010:key/orch-555",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:EncryptionContext:project": "orchid"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

raja_security: Also note: default masking replaces fields named `prompt`/`user_text` with SHA256 and strips obvious PII. Raw prompt export requires signed addendum.

tom_sre: For egress latency: staging with VPCE + uploader = median 26s. NAT path = 38s. Canary plan: run PUT after SG done and confirm object arrives within 40s to satisfy their SLA.

olivia_orchid: Thanks. A few clarifications: 1) who holds Decrypt? 2) can we get a one-page chain-of-custody for auditors? 3) will hashed-only logs pass our compliance? We may request raw in edge cases.

raja_security: Answer: Redwood retains a Decrypt-capable envelope key in our account. Customer KMS only used to Encrypt and generate data keys; we avoid giving cross-account Decrypt. We'll produce a one-page chain-of-custody + rotation cadence (customer KMS 90d, Redwood envelope key 30d). Hashed-only logs usually satisfy privacy teams; if you need raw, we need signed Addendum.

alex_cs: Action items: 1) @mira_net publish VPCE & route table in runbook, 2) @tom_sre run canary once SG present, 3) @raja_security send chain-of-custody + KMS snippet to Orchid admin, 4) Olivia to confirm KMS policy acceptance. I'll mark renewal "elevated" until canary + policy accepted.

ci-bot: Dry-run scheduled: 2026-10-04T10:00:00Z. Staging result: VPCE + uploader median 25s; Object Lock test PASS.

mira_net: SG added: sg-0a2b3c4d, route table posted: rtb-0b1c2d3e. VPCE active.

olivia_orchid: Applied KMS snippet with EncryptionContext project=orchid. Running small canary now.

tom_sre: Canary result: 200 OK from Orchid VPC -> collector, S3 object visible in Redwood account in 32s. Canary PASS. :white_check_mark:

raja_security: Sent chain-of-custody + rotation doc to Orchid security email. Also included Object Lock example config for 5y retention and attestation template.

olivia_orchid: Received, looks good. We'll sign the attestation and confirm tomorrow.

alex_cs: Great. Moving renewal from "elevated" -> "monitor" pending signed attestation. Closing when attestation returns. Thanks all :thumbsup:
